summary.name: Ajelix
summary.one_liner: Ajelix is an agentic AI chat workspace for business that uploads your files and produces working deliverables such as Excel files, dashboards, PowerPoint decks and web apps.
use_cases: generating Excel formulas and VBA scripts
building interactive dashboards from uploaded data
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Ajelix as an agentic AI workspace where users upload files (spreadsheets, PDFs, CSVs, documents, up to 1GB) that persist across conversations. Users ask for a task and receive working deliverables such as formatted Excel files with formulas, live dashboards, web apps, PowerPoint presentations, VBA scripts and cleaned datasets. It also offers Excel-specific features including formula help, VBA code writing, error fixing and visualizations. A saved Asset Library and Prompt Library allow reuse of charts, dashboards and workflows. The page also mentions access to several AI models and says the company is GDPR compliant.
notable: Persistent workspace where uploaded files carry across chats (up to 1GB)
Generates working deliverables like Excel files, dashboards, PowerPoint decks and web apps rather than only advice
Asset Library and Prompt Library for reusing charts, dashboards and saved workflows
Claims GDPR compliance and that customer data is not used to train models
caveats: Listing marks the tool as paid
Claims such as 'most precise' Excel tool and up to 50% faster task execution are based on the company's own survey and experience, not independently verified
Page mixes product content with extensive enterprise marketing for a separate sovereign AI offering, so the scope of the product described is not fully clear
